verdict.rationale: Moss has a documented HTTP API (a multiplexed /v1/manage endpoint) and an llms.txt, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file and the human-readable API reference are adjacent material, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
